title: Foundations for Accessibility
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Foundations for Accessibility Certiﬁcate of Achievement
outcomes: Identify the appropriate law that applies to an accessibility barrier.
Demonstrate knowledge of the application of Section 504, & Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, WACAG, and the Americans with Disabilities Act. (ADA).
Describe what technology is covered in Information and Communication Technology (ICT).
Identify how to apply accessible guidelines to create and remediate documents to ensure accessibility.
Demonstrate creating a new accessible document.
Describe how creating accessible documents empowers persons with disabilities.
Identify the appropriate assistive technology to support an individual's educational limitations.
Demonstrate knowledge of at least one assistive technology.
Describe how assistive technology can support students with disabilities.

notes: Read only the Foundations for Accessibility Certificate of Achievement section; preceding Digital Design & Production sections belong to other awards.

The description names audiences (general and special educators, related service personnel, adult service providers, families or caregivers) as those who gain supplemental knowledge, not as careers the program prepares for; careers left empty.
Page notes the certificate does not qualify for Title IV Federal Funding.
Award type says 8 to fewer than 16 units; catalog total of 9 is consistent.
